facts.fact: 四天囚禁：他每天看她睡觉，对抗吸血的冲动——可以转化她、可以杀了她，但他都没有做。
facts.anchor: Since then, I’ve fought my urge to drink her blood.

facts.fact: Edie 对这间卧室的判词：这就是监狱，而他是狱卒。
facts.anchor: “This is a prison, and you’re my jailor,” she whispers.

facts.fact: 他承认对 Basilia 很差、错了，补不回伤害——这份愧疚他背了三百年，之后只带回过 Edie 一人。
facts.anchor: I’ve lived with the guilt for three hundred years.

facts.fact: 他三百年只造了三个同类：Sybil、Logan、Viktor——因为不想再有人被同样的命运困住。
facts.anchor: I’ve only ever sired three vampires; Sybil, Logan and Viktor.

facts.fact: 壁画场景：他亲手画下故乡 Grayhaven 的崖景，怀念阳光落在皮肤上的感觉，梦里也常回到日光下。
facts.anchor: “I miss the feeling of the sun on my skin.

facts.fact: Basilia 死那天为他画了一幅肖像；他相信那幅画就是他诅咒的催化剂，可她死得太早，他永远问不清。
facts.anchor: I believe, somehow, that painting was the catalyst to my curse.

facts.fact: 他一承认感情，纹身就暴动：撕裂皮肉、扯开肌肉、钻进骨头，骨头接连断裂。
facts.anchor: my tattoos tearing through my flesh, ripping apart my muscles, digging into my bones.

facts.fact: 收章：Edie 把脖子递给他、逼他吸；他破了自己「不再咬她」的誓，刺进她的皮肤吸血。
facts.anchor: she shouts, and so I do what I vowed I wouldn’t do again. I pierce her flesh and feast on her blood.
